notes.title: Update notes: Muffin and Uncle Stripe
notes.notes:
This update includes:

New characters added to the selection line-up. Play as Muffin and Uncle Stripe.

Search for special character-related collectibles. Find all the colourful flamingos with Muffin and help squash-obsessed Uncle Stripe collect the rackets.

7 new costumes. Gather stars to unlock them.

Unlock new pictures to upgrade the look of your sticker book.

General improvements and minor bug fixing.

notes.title: Bluey: The Videogame | Free Update Avaliable
notes.notes:
Hey, Bluey fans! 

We’ve got a new free update for you! Thanks to the valuable feedback from our players, we’ve improved user experience with tons of fixes and optimisations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44636198/640539954eeb9fe08b090eb62badd8b6f09f8a06.png

New additions:


 Enjoy classic games with new rules. Keepy Uppy, Magic Xylophone, Chattermax Chase, and  Ground is Lava now have 5 stars to collect!
 Each game is set in its own unique fun new location 
 Use the new Games Book to quickly travel to each new game location


New rules! New objects! New interactions! 

Explore Bluey’s world with new items to unlock and keep your eyes open for more updates coming soon!
